level.title: Elementary: 了/过, ability, places, food
goals: Talk about past with 了 and 过
Express ability with 会/能/可以
Move around, eat out and shop

lessons.title: 了 and 过
lessons.learn: Past helpers! Verb + 了 (completed): 我吃了 (I ate). Didn't: 没吃 (NOT 不吃 for past!). Experience: 过 (have done): 我吃过 (I've eaten before). 已经 = already!

grammar.title: Verb了 · 没verb · Verb过
grammar.explain: 我吃了 (I ate), 我没吃 (I didn't eat), 我吃过 (I've eaten before). 没 = past-negative! 过 = ever-experience!

mistakes: Saying 不吃 for past — past-negative: 没吃!
Saying 吃了过 — pick ONE: 了 or 过!

lessons.title: 会/能/可以 + 想/要
lessons.learn: Three CANS! 会 (learned skill: 我会说中文), 能 (able: 我能去), 可以 (may/allowed: 可以进来吗?). Wants: 想 (would like), 要 (want/will). 想喝茶 (I'd like tea), 我要走了 (I'm leaving)!

grammar.title: 会/能/可以 + 想/要
grammar.explain: 我会游泳 (I can swim — learned), 我能来 (I can come — able), 可以坐吗? (may I sit?). 想吃 (would like to eat), 我要茶 (I want tea / I'll have tea)!
mistakes: Saying 我能说中文 for skills — skills: 会!
Saying 我要想 — pick ONE: 想 or 要!

lessons.title: Explain a travel delay
lessons.learn: Describe a delay, state what you have already done and ask about the next step.

grammar.title: completed action with 了
grammar.explain: Use 了 for a completed action. Keep a later plan separate from what has already happened.

examples.r: huǒ chē wǎn diǎn le èr shí fēn zhōng。
examples.en: The train was delayed by twenty minutes.

examples.r: wǒ yǐ jīng gǎi qiān le chē piào。
examples.en: I have already changed the ticket.

examples.r: qǐng wèn xià yì bān jǐ diǎn chū fā？
examples.en: May I ask what time the next service leaves?

mistakes.why: Place 了 after the verb and before its object here.

lessons.title: 在/去/从…到
lessons.learn: Move! 在 (at), 去 (go to), 从…到 (from…to): 从家到学校 (from home to school). 这里/那里/哪里 = here/there/where! 你去哪里? = Where are you going?

grammar.title: 在 · 去 · 从…到
grammar.explain: 我在家 (I'm at home), 我去学校 (I go to school), 从北京到上海 (from Beijing to Shanghai). Verbs of going demand 去!
mistakes: Saying 我在去学校 — going: 我去学校!
Saying 我去在家 — at-home: 我在家!

lessons.title: 去/来/回 + 点
lessons.learn: Move! 去 (go), 来 (come), 回 (return). Time + 点: 六点 (6 o'clock), 六点半 (6:30). 明天我去北京 = Tomorrow I go to Beijing. Leaving: 我走了! Back: 我回来了!!

grammar.title: Movement + 点 time
grammar.explain: 六点去 (go at 6), 明天来 (come tomorrow). Leaving home: 我走了! Return: 我回来了! Family: 回来了!

lessons.title: Give a reason for a preference
lessons.learn: State a preference and connect it to a practical reason.

grammar.title: reason and result
grammar.explain: 因为 introduces a reason. In a short answer, 因为 alone can be enough; avoid stacking both connectors unnecessarily.

examples.t: 我喜欢早上出发，因为路上比较安静。
examples.r: wǒ xǐ huān zǎo shàng chū fā，yīn wèi lù shàng bǐ jiào ān jìng。
examples.en: I like leaving in the morning because the road is quieter.

examples.t: 车站离家近，所以去那里很方便。
examples.r: chē zhàn lí jiā jìn，suǒ yǐ qù nà lǐ hěn fāng biàn。
examples.en: The station is close to home, so getting there is convenient.

examples.t: 我们可以先比较两个时间。
examples.r: wǒ men kě yǐ xiān bǐ jiào liǎng gè shí jiān。
examples.en: We can compare the two times first.

mistakes.wrong: 因为车站近，所以因此很方便。
mistakes.right: 车站离家近，所以很方便。
mistakes.why: Use one result connector, not 所以 and 因此 together.

lessons.title: Shopping: 多少钱
lessons.learn: Shop in Chinese! 多少钱? (How much?), 贵 (expensive), 便宜 (cheap). Money: 块/元 (yuan). 这个/那个 = this one/that one. 我要这个 = I'll take this! 太贵了! = Too expensive!

grammar.title: 多少钱? + 这个/那个
grammar.explain: 这个多少钱? (How much is this one?), 一百块 (100 yuan). 我要这个! = I'll take this one! 太…了 = too: 太贵了!
grammar.pattern: 这个 + 多少钱? · 太 + adj + 了
mistakes: Saying 多少 without 钱 — prices: 多少钱!
Saying 这多少钱 — ones: 这个多少钱!

lessons.title: Make a simple booking
lessons.learn: Ask whether a room is available and confirm the dates.

grammar.title: availability with 有
grammar.pattern: 还有 + number + classifier + noun 吗？
grammar.explain: Use 还有 to ask whether something remains available, then confirm the dates explicitly.

items.q: Say: Yesterday I read a book

culture.text: 您 is a respectful form of 你, but address choices depend on relationship, setting and local habit. A friendly conversation may use 你, while a service interaction may choose 您. Learners should listen to how people address one another instead of treating one form as universally required.

reading.text: 小周昨天去过新图书馆。她说那里很安静，书也很多。朋友问她怎么去，她解释了公交路线，还提醒朋友周末要先查开放时间。
reading.gloss: Xiao Zhou has been to the new library. She said it was quiet and had many books. A friend asked how to get there; she explained the bus route and reminded the friend to check opening hours first on the weekend.

listening.script:
朋友：你去过新图书馆吗？
小周：去过，那里很安静。
朋友：周末我也想去。
小周：出发前先查一下开放时间。
listening.gloss: Friend: Have you been to the new library? Xiao Zhou: Yes, it is quiet there. Friend: I want to go this weekend too. Xiao Zhou: Check the opening hours before you leave.

idioms.meaning: we will meet there; do not leave
to achieve two benefits at once
the story needs a longer explanation
there is no way; it cannot be helped

mistakes.why: 了 and 过 express different aspect meanings; avoid stacking them here.
会 marks a learned ability; do not add 可以 without a permission meaning.
Ask price with 多少钱; do not add a second price marker.
